challenges.title: A ledger with typed errors
challenges.prompt: Implement apply for a small ledger: parse each line, update balances in a BTreeMap and report failures with a custom error enum, a Display impl and a From conversion so the ? operator works. Valid lines must still be applied when others fail.
challenges.expected:
error: overdraft on bo: 50
error: bad amount: invalid digit found in string
error: bad line: ana transfer 5
error: bad line: ana deposit
ana: 70
bo: 0
errors: 4
challenges.explain: The match on the verb gives a signed delta, entry().or_insert(0) creates accounts on demand and the overdraft check happens before the balance changes. The From<ParseIntError> impl is what lets ? convert the parse error. Verified by compiling and running with Rust 1.97.

challenges.title: Count primes with worker threads
challenges.prompt: Share a counter in an Arc<Mutex<u32>> so worker threads claim chunks of 1000 numbers, count primes in each chunk and send results over an mpsc channel. The totals must match a single-worker run.
challenges.expected:
primes below 10000: 1229
chunks: 10
first three: [(0, 168), (1000, 135), (2000, 127)]
same with one worker: true
challenges.explain: The lock is held only while claiming the next chunk, the channel closes when every sender is dropped (the original tx is dropped explicitly) and sorting the results makes the output deterministic even though threads finish in any order. 1229 is the number of primes below 10,000. Verified by compiling and running with Rust 1.97.
